source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Record the date, time, and specific location of the accident.
3. Write down the names and job titles of employees involved and witnesses.
4. Briefly describe what happened without speculating on cause.
5. Note the immediate action taken (any first aid, evacuation, emergency services called).
6. Clearly state types of injuries suffered, if any, and first aid or medical treatment provided.
7. Photograph the accident scene (without disturbing evidence).
8. Include written statements from all involved and any witnesses.
9. Detail any safety protocol violations or equipment failures noted.
10. Attach copies of any relevant documentation (safety checks, maintenance logs) to the report.
11. Document any environmental, health, or safety hazards that contributed to or resulted from the incident.
12. Include information on any immediate corrective actions taken. 
13. Conclude with a summary of the incident, noting any further investigation needed.
